assumptions: utilities lie in [0,1] and thresholds lie in (0,1]
epsilon is in (0,1/2] and 1/epsilon is an integer
membership queries return whether expected utility is at least the threshold
Select returns the lexicographically maximum lottery satisfying every learned halfspace, or Null
claim: Algorithm 2 returns a unanimously acceptable lottery exactly when one exists and uses O(n^2 + n m log(1/epsilon)) membership queries in the worst case.
failure_conditions: a returned lottery is rejected by any agent
Null is returned for a feasible instance
any exact query count exceeds the independently derived finite envelope
a proof obligation or negative control fails
